The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
The stuffs here are giving out awful smell.\nNo idea what they are but they just smell terrible...
Agwe ghe ghe... *cough*!\nWhat's this smell?!\nI feel I'm about to faint...
I'm exaggerating, you say?!\nCules are way more sensitive to smell than you!
When you say something smells bad, the smell could\nkill us!\nAggggghhhh!! I can't take it any more!!
You have blasted the Demi Machina Factory!
...We've went through a lot but fortunately,\nwe've blown the factory of Demi Machinas up.\nOkay, let's go back and report it to the King.
Thanks for blowing the vexing factory up...\nBut too bad. That's not the only one.
What is worse, the remaining factory is creating\nmuch larger and more heavily equipped Demi\nMachinas...
What?! T-That's a problem!\nHey! Where's that?!
Heh, don't rush. I'll tell you.\nIt's near here. But there's one condition...
Huh? What's that...?
It's not difficult.\nJust destroy the factory like you did last time...
I tell you the place and you destroy it.\nYou can eliminate the threats and...
I can feel relieved that the nauseous and annoying\nfactory is gone... It's not a bad deal, huh?
Are you... going to betray Empire of Lyark?
NO WAY!! I am a black knight!\nAn elite knight of the Empire!\nHow could I betray the Empire?!
I don't want you to misunderstand that such\nugly stuffs like Demi Machinas are the main force\nof Lyark...
I just can't stand that our pride as a black knight\nis being disgraced because of them!
The factory is at the bottom of Sykea Deep Valley.\nIt's way larger than the factory that you blew up.\nSo, the security is tighter too...Just don't die.
